# Security policy

Do not report a vulnerability in a pull request, in a public channel, in a Larixy community, or in a direct message to staff.

Report it privately through GitHub: <https://github.com/Lyxtem/Larixy/security/advisories/new>. If you do not have a GitHub account, open a support ticket in the official Larixy server and ask for a private channel for a security report, without including the details in the ticket.

Include the affected component, impact, reproduction steps, and supporting evidence. Remove unrelated personal data and secrets.

The programme scope, testing rules, safe harbour, disclosure process, and recognition terms are published at <https://larixy.xyz/security>. That page is authoritative.
